metaDescription: Order custom sublimation lanyards & badges with full-color designs. Perfect for events, IDs, and branding. Get a quote today!
introHtml: Sublimation printing allows your logo or artwork to become part of the fabric itself, resulting in vibrant, durable lanyards that won't peel or fade. Unlike screen printing, sublimation supports full-color gradients and photographic details, making it ideal for complex designs or brand colors. Whether you need printed breakaway lanyards for safety compliance or full-color badge reels for employee IDs, sublimation delivers a professional finish that lasts through daily wear.
heroAltText: Custom sublimation lanyards and badges with full-color dye-sublimated designs and breakaway clasps.
